When it comes to CBD gummies, the choice between oil-based and water-based options is crucial for bioavailability and absorption. Water-based CBD gummies offer superior absorption compared to oil-based versions.

The human body, being predominantly water, integrates water-based CBD more efficiently, leading to faster and more effective results. This enhanced absorption means your body utilizes more of the CBD.

  • Faster and more effective absorption
  • Higher bioavailability compared to oil-based gummies
  • More efficient utilization of CBD by the body
Water-based CBD gummies represent a significant advancement in how CBD is delivered to your system, ensuring that you get the most out of every dose.

settings.title: Why Choose NextEvo Naturals CBD Capsules?

settings.title: How Do NextEvo Naturals CBD Capsules Work?
settings.text: NextEvo Naturals CBD capsules work by delivering a measured dose of CBD directly into the body. The capsules are swallowed and digested, allowing the water-soluble CBD to be absorbed through the digestive system and metabolized by the liver. From there, the CBD enters the bloodstream and interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which plays a role in regulating various functions such as mood, sleep, and pain. With regular use, NextEvo Naturals CBD capsules can potentially help support overall wellness and balance within the body.

settings.title: How Many CBD Capsules Should I Take?
settings.text: The number of capsules to take depends on the dose per capsule. You should always start with the recommended daily dosage on the bottle. When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated. You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you. Successful customers often report that a daily maximum of 80-120mg (30-40 mgs, 2-3 times per day) works best. We recommend giving it 4-6 weeks at your maximum dose to determine if the supplements are effective for your needs. Additionally, we recommend taking our CBD with food to enhance absorption by the body.

settings.title: How do CBD capsules compare to CBD oil?
settings.text: CBD capsules and CBD oil are two popular CBD consumption methods with some key differences. CBD capsules typically contain pre-measured doses of CBD, making them convenient and easy to use. They are also tasteless and can be taken discreetly. CBD oil, on the other hand, is more difficult to properly dose out and offers far less superior absorption in the human body which is made of mostly water. Thus, when choosing CBD, it's best to opt for water-soluble forms of CBD such as capsules, gummies, dissolvable powders, and topicals.

settings.title: What are 10mg CBD capsules used for?

settings.title: How do I choose the best CBD capsules?
settings.text: Selecting the best CBD capsules involves considering several factors. Start by checking the product's source of CBD and ensure that it is derived from high-quality hemp plants and made in water-soluble format as CBD in oil format does not absorb well in the human body. Look for third-party lab test results to verify the potency and purity of the capsules and that they are THC free. Consider the dosage strength that aligns with your specific needs and preferences. Additionally, check for any additional ingredients in the capsules and ensure they meet your dietary requirements. Finally, read customer reviews and consider the brand's reputation for quality and transparency. These considerations will guide you in choosing the best CBD capsules for you.

settings.title: What are the benefits of CBD capsules versus CBD oil?
settings.text: CBD capsules offer a convenient, discreet, and precise dosing alternative to CBD oil. They eliminate the taste issue some users have with CBD oil, as capsules are tasteless and odorless. The encapsulation protects the CBD from oxidation and degradation, potentially increasing shelf life. Capsules also ensure consistent dosage, removing the variability that can come with oil dropper use. Additionally, when created using water-soluble CBD, capsules have 4X better absorption by the human body compared to oil. However, they need to be digested before the CBD is absorbed into the bloodstream.

settings.title: Are CBD capsules beneficial for digestion?
settings.text: CBD capsules can potentially offer digestive benefits for some individuals. The endocannabinoid system, which interacts with CBD, plays a role in regulating various bodily functions, including digestion. CBD's potential anti-inflammatory properties may help soothe digestive issues and promote a healthy gut environment. Additionally, CBD capsules offer a convenient, pre-measured way to incorporate CBD into your daily routine. However, individual results may vary, and it's important to consult with a healthcare professional before adding any new supplement to your regimen, especially if you have specific digestive concerns.

settings.title: Do CBD capsules really work?
settings.text: CBD capsules have shown promising benefits for many individuals, but it's important to note that individual responses can vary. CBD works by interacting with the endocannabinoid system, which helps regulate various bodily functions, including inflammation and stress response. While research is ongoing and more clinical studies are needed, many people have reported positive effects from CBD capsules. It's always best to consult with a healthcare professional to determine if CBD capsules may be a suitable option for you based on your specific health needs.

settings.title: How many mg of CBD a day is too much?
settings.text: It is always recommended that you speak with your healthcare provider before beginning a CBD regimen. When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated. You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you. Successful customers often report that a daily maximum of 80-120mg (30-40 mgs, 2-3 times per day) works best. We recommend giving it 4-6 weeks at your maximum dose to determine if the supplements are effective for your needs. Additionally, we recommend taking our CBD with food to enhance absorption by the body.

settings.title: What does taking CBD pills do?
settings.text: Taking CBD pills can provide various health benefits, similar to other forms of CBD. They are primarily used to alleviate feelings of stress, manage pain associated with inflammation, and improve sleep quality. Pills offer a discreet, convenient, and precise way to consume CBD. They are particularly suitable for those who dislike the taste of CBD oil. It's important to start with a low dose and adjust as needed.

settings.title: What is the difference between whole plant and full spectrum CBD capsules?
settings.text: The difference between whole plant and full spectrum CBD capsules is in the composition of the extracts. Whole plant CBD capsules contain all components of the cannabis plant, including CBD, THC, other cannabinoids, terpenes, and plant matter. This offers the full range of benefits of the cannabis plant, including the entourage effect. Full spectrum CBD capsules also contain a range of cannabinoids and terpenes like whole plant capsules, but they typically have less plant matter, focusing more on the extracted cannabinoids and terpenes.

settings.title: Who should avoid taking CBD capsules?
settings.text: People who should avoid taking CBD capsules include those who are pregnant or breastfeeding, as the effects on fetal development or breastfed infants are not fully understood. Individuals taking medications that interact with grapefruit should also be cautious, as CBD can interact similarly. Those with liver disease or significant liver function issues should consult a doctor before taking CBD, as it can affect liver enzyme levels. It’s always advisable to consult with a healthcare provider before starting any new supplement, including CBD capsules.

settings.title: Why take CBD capsules for wellness instead of oil?
settings.text: Choosing CBD capsules for wellness over oil can be preferable for those seeking optimal absorption, convenience, precise dosing, and discretion. Capsules provide a pre-measured dose of CBD, eliminating the need for measuring and potential messiness associated with oil. They are tasteless and odorless, ideal for those sensitive to the taste of CBD oil. CBD capsules are also easy to incorporate into a daily supplement routine and are travel-friendly. They offer a straightforward and hassle-free way to maintain consistent CBD intake for wellness purposes. Most importantly, our water-soluble CBD capsules over 4X better absorption compared oil-based CBD brands.

settings.title: Will CBD pills make you sleepy?
settings.text: CBD pills can have a sedative effect, particularly in higher doses. They may induce a sense of relaxation and calm, which can help improve sleep quality. However, CBD does not inherently cause drowsiness or sleepiness. The effect depends on the individual's response, the CBD dosage, and the specific formulation of the pills. Some people might experience drowsiness as a side effect, while others may not notice any impact on their alertness. It's advisable to monitor how your body reacts to CBD pills and adjust the timing and dosage accordingly.
